children: The consumer confidence indicator in the Czech Republic rose to 105.1 in September 2026 from 102.3 in August, marking the first improvement after two consecutive monthly declines.
The increase was driven by a more positive economic outlook, with the share of consumers expecting the overall economic situation to deteriorate over the next 12 months decreasing month-on-month.
Sentiment toward household finances also strengthened slightly, with expectations for an improvement over the next 12 months edging higher.
Meanwhile, assessments of households’ current financial situation were broadly unchanged from August, while the share of consumers postponing major purchases over the next year declined marginally.

title: Czech Republic Consumer Morale Improves in September
